ordered_diagnoses: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute monocular visual disturbance with optic disc swelling and retinal lesions in a young adult with a history of neurofibroma
salient_findings: Grey dot in central vision of left eye
Swollen optic disc in right eye
Parafoveal grey-white deep retinal lesion in left eye
Cotton-wool spot in posterior pole of left eye
Central scotoma in left eye
key_facts: 18-year-old Chinese woman
Known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm
No medical history, trauma, family history, smoking, or illicit drug use
Visual acuity 20/20 in right eye and 20/25 in left eye
No relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild subcapsular cataracts bilaterally
Blood pressure 110/70 mmHg
Normal carotid Doppler ultrasound and transthoracic echocardiography
Normal laboratory studies, including complete blood count and liver enzymes
Bilateral vestibular schwannomas, parasellar mass, and cervical extramedullary lesion on brain MRI

shortlist.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has known plexiform neurofibroma and bilateral vestibular schwannomas

shortlist.label: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Swept-source optical coherence tomography showed hyperreflective bands in the inner nuclear layer

shortlist.label: Optic neuritis
shortlist.why_kept: Swollen optic disc in the right eye and central scotoma in the left eye

shortlist.label: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's age and presentation with acute monocular visual disturbance

shortlist.label: Neuromyelitis optica
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has optic disc swelling and retinal lesions, and some cases can present with similar symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient has a known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm and bilateral vestibular schwannomas, a parasellar mass, and a cervical extramedullary lesion, which are characteristic features of Neurofibromatosis type 1.

rejected.label: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has a parafoveal grey-white deep retinal lesion consistent with paracentral acute middle maculopathy, this condition does not explain the other systemic findings such as plexiform neurofibroma and bilateral vestibular schwannomas.

rejected.label: Optic neuritis
rejected.why: The patient does not have a relative afferent pupillary defect, and the visual acuity is relatively preserved, making optic neuritis less likely.

rejected.label: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy
rejected.why: The patient's fundus examination and fluorescein angiography findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Neuromyelitis optica
rejected.why: The patient does not have a history of optic neuritis or transverse myelitis, and the brain MRI does not show lesions characteristic of neuromyelitis optica.
